text: So sorry to message this late, I'm probably being silly. I'm looking after my niece Amara, she's 7, and she's had a slight temperature today, 37.7. Tonight I noticed some little dark marks on her and I'm not sure what they are. Her skin is very dark so it's hard to see on her arms and legs, but I looked at the palms of her hands and the soles of her feet and there are tiny purplish dots there, and I think a couple inside her bottom eyelid when I pulled it down gently. I pressed a glass on her palm like I saw online and I don't think they went away, they still looked the same through the glass. Also she says her neck hurts and she won't put her chin down to her chest. When I asked her to look at her tummy she just moved her eyes and wouldn't bend her head. Not sure if she's just being stubborn. She's been going to the toilet for wees like normal and there's been no shaking or jerking or anything like that. Sorry again, her mum is away and I didn't know who else to ask.
